name: io.github.SarutobiSasuke8/obsidian-github-mcp
title: Obsidian GitHub MCP
description: A permissioned MCP gateway for agent proposals to a Git-backed Obsidian vault.

client_token.description: Existing operator-provisioned MCP client token, not the GitHub token.

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_MCP_GITHUB_OWNER
environmentVariables.description: Owner of the operator-authorised vault repository.

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_MCP_POLICY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the operator-provisioned policy YAML.

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_MCP_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the operator-provisioned client-token YAML.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required for the token-based quickstart. Alternatively configure all three GitHub App variables documented in README.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_APP_ID
environmentVariables.description: GitHub App alternative: set all three App variables instead of GITHUB_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_APP_INSTALLATION_ID
environmentVariables.description: GitHub App installation ID, required with GITHUB_APP_ID.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the operator-provisioned App private key; required with GITHUB_APP_ID.
